title: qbr-deck template variables
description: Values for templates/qbr-deck.md.j2 and templates/qbr-deck.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from qbr-deck.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

client_name.description: Which client is this QBR for - the name as it appears on the contract and as they would want to see it on a slide?

dashboard_url.title: Dashboard url
dashboard_url.description: Where does the outcomes and metrics evidence live - one link the client can open themselves? A QBR number with no dashboard behind it is a claim.

finance_snapshot_url.title: Finance snapshot url
finance_snapshot_url.description: Where is the finance snapshot for this account - the P&L view the numbers on slide 7 come from? Check who can see it before you paste it into a client deck.

owner_full_name.description: Who owns this account and presents the deck? One named human, on every slide, so the client knows who to call between reviews.

period_label.description: Which quarter does this review cover (e.g. 2026-Q3)? The quarter being reviewed, not the one you are about to plan.

ticket_ids.title: Ticket ids
ticket_ids.description: Which tickets evidence the wins and the risks? List the ids; they are what turns 'we shipped a lot' into something the client can check.
